gate_kinds.physics-level: GATE-L1, GATE-L2 and GATE-L3 open a paper physics level; they stay closed until their typed manifest is accepted.
gate_kinds.numerical-campaign: Admits one accepted, preregistered numerical campaign about a declared component model (the collisionless test-particle wall-loss campaign on one qualified field; the robust multi-objective optimisation campaign on the L0 model under the declared closure CL-1). It opens no physics level (opens_level is null), must be accepted (never closed), and its manifest is cross-checked against the sealed results bundle, the hash-bound evidence file, the bound section and the claim matrix by a campaign-specific checker in check_paper.py.
gate_kinds.numerical-screening: Admits one preregistered, single-execution screening study on L1a linear-vacuum equivalent-current fields (no permanent-magnet or nonlinear-iron material model; not P2-qualified) at exactly its recorded outcome, declared as recorded_outcome: accepted-screening (a field-only design-space screening), preregistered-null, recorded-characterization, or accepted-screening-dataset (a collisionless test-particle wall-loss dataset integrated in those fields over a design space, accepted as surrogate and optimisation input only when carried with its label). The gate status accepted means the study is admitted as recorded, never that a positive finding is accepted; a null is admitted as a null under the frozen definitions and is not an existence disproof; a screening dataset is admitted as screening input and is never accepted physical-orbit, plasma or performance evidence. It opens no physics level (opens_level is null), its typed manifest is cross-checked against the sealed bundle, the hash-bound evidence file, the audited end-of-line tolerances where a bundle needs one, the bound section and the claim matrix by the screening checkers in check_paper.py, and it never opens GATE-L1.
gate_kinds.analytic-consistency: Admits one analytic consistency result about a declared equation set: a derivation whose closed form is verified numerically to a stated tolerance and pinned by committed tests (the reduced global power row of the corrected four-cell discharge ledger and its consequence that no admissible root exists for any positive interior cusp probability). The gate status accepted means the derivation and its numerical verification are admitted as recorded; it is not a statement about the physical thruster, it does not accept any proposed correction of the equation set (the proposal stays PROPOSED_NOT_ACCEPTED), and it opens no physics level (opens_level is null; never GATE-L1, GATE-L2 or GATE-L3). Its typed manifest binds the analysis document, the ledger entry, the executed diagnostics and solver sources, the pinning tests, the frozen MDO protocol disclosure and the legacy lineage blob at the analysis revision; the paper generator recomputes the numerical verification from the checkout package at every check, refuses if the executed package differs from the bound blobs or if any recomputed number departs from the analysis document beyond the declared tolerance, and the analysis checker in check_paper.py cross-checks the manifest against the evidence file, the bound section, the displayed closed form and the claim matrix.

gates.title: Preregistered robust multi-objective optimisation of the L0 model under declared cusp-probability uncertainty, campaign v1
gates.kind_justification: The numerical-campaign kind admits one accepted, preregistered numerical campaign about a declared component model. Here the component model is the accepted L0 conservation model (cft_revival.physics, L0-conservation-reduced-performance) evaluated under the declared multiplicative cusp-survival closure CL-1 and declared uniform priors, and the campaign is one accepted single execution (8 of 8 binding gates, terminal state accepted_result). The kind therefore fits and is reused with its own typed manifest, evidence file, macro-only section, claim records and campaign checker. The campaign is optimiser evidence (hypervolume per budget, paired comparisons, seed variance, Pareto sizes, robust-versus-nominal fronts, sensitivity to the cusp prior), not performance evidence: it makes no thruster-performance, plasma or physical-device claim, contains no field solve, geometry variable or L0 mapping, and opens none of GATE-L1, GATE-L2 or GATE-L3.

gates.title: Consistency of the corrected four-cell power balance: closed form of the global power row and absence of admissible roots for interior cusp probabilities
gates.kind_justification: The admitted object is a derivation about a declared equation set, the corrected four-cell discharge ledger (28 rows, 25 unknowns): substituting rows R00-R26 into the global power row leaves a closed form whose two terms are non-negative on the admissible region, so the equation set has no admissible root for any positive interior cusp probability. Nothing was executed under a preregistered protocol (so it is not a numerical campaign), no design space was screened (so it is not a numerical screening), and no field, plasma or experimental evidence enters (so it is not a physics level). A new kind, analytic-consistency, therefore admits it: the closed form is verified numerically to a stated tolerance, pinned by committed tests, and recomputed by the checker from the bound cft_revival.plasma package at every run. Status accepted means the derivation and its numerical verification are admitted as recorded; the proposed correction stays PROPOSED_NOT_ACCEPTED, nothing is claimed about the physical thruster, and GATE-L1, GATE-L2 and GATE-L3 stay closed.
